license_required.quote: A person must be licensed in order to use the CPA title in Virginia.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Virginia Board of Accountancy.

name.quote: "Board" means the Virginia Board of Accountancy.

type.quote: The Board of Accountancy established under the former § 54.1-2000 and previously operating in the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation is hereby continued and reestablished as an independent board in the executive branch of state government.

moral_character_required.quote: The Board has the authority to refuse to grant a person the privilege of using the CPA title in Virginia if, based upon all the information available, the Board finds that the person is unfit or unsuited to use the CPA title in Virginia.

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or higher degree with accounting concentration or equivalent, plus at least 150 semester hours of education (for persons seeking licensure prior to January 1, 2026); baccalaureate or higher degree with accounting concentration or equivalent (for persons seeking licensure on or after January 1, 2026)
degree_required.quote: provide documentation that he has obtained from one or more accredited institutions at least 150 semester hours of education, a baccalaureate or higher degree, and an accounting concentration or equivalent, as defined by the Board. For a person seeking licensure on or after January 1, 2026, provide documentation that he has obtained from one or more accredited institutions a baccalaureate or higher degree and an accounting concentration or equivalent, as defined by the Board

accrediting_body.value: Regional accrediting organizations (Middle States Association of Colleges and Schools, New England Commission of Higher Education, Higher Learning Commission, Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities, Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges, and WASC Senior College and University Commission) or equivalent approved by the Board
accrediting_body.quote: "Accredited institution" means a degree-granting institution of higher education accredited either by (i) one of the regional accrediting organizations, including the Middle States Association of Colleges and Schools, New England Commission of Higher Education, Higher Learning Commission, Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities, Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges, and WASC Senior College and University Commission, or their successors or (ii) an accrediting organization demonstrating to the Board periodically, as prescribed by the Board, that its accreditation process and standards are substantially equivalent to the accreditation process and standards of the regional accrediting organizations.

degree_level.quote: a baccalaureate or higher degree, and an accounting concentration or equivalent, as defined by the Board

school_approval_basis.quote: a degree-granting institution of higher education accredited either by (i) one of the regional accrediting organizations, including the Middle States Association of Colleges and Schools, New England Commission of Higher Education, Higher Learning Commission, Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities, Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges, and WASC Senior College and University Commission

tiers.quote: For a person seeking licensure on or after January 1, 2026, provide documentation that he has obtained from one or more accredited institutions a baccalaureate or higher degree and an accounting concentration or equivalent, as defined by the Board

required.quote: For a person seeking licensure on or after January 1, 2026, provide documentation of qualifying experience as determined by the Board, which shall include: (a) Two years of experience for a person who has obtained a baccalaureate degree. The Board shall permit at least 30 additional semester hours of education beyond the minimum hours required for a baccalaureate degree to be substituted for one year of experience; or (b) One year of experience for a person who has obtained a master's degree.

experience_source.quote: For a person seeking licensure on or after January 1, 2026, provide documentation of qualifying experience as determined by the Board, which shall include: (a) Two years of experience for a person who has obtained a baccalaureate degree. ... (b) One year of experience for a person who has obtained a master's degree.

duration.value: Two years (baccalaureate) or one year (master's), for licensure on or after January 1, 2026; prior to January 1, 2026, experience as determined by the Board
duration.quote: Two years of experience for a person who has obtained a baccalaureate degree. ... One year of experience for a person who has obtained a master's degree.

kind.value: employment in academia, firm, government, or industry involving substantial use of accounting, financial, tax, or other relevant skills, verified by an active, licensed CPA
kind.quote: "Experience" means employment in academia, a firm, government, or an industry in any capacity involving the substantial use of accounting, financial, tax, or other skills that are relevant, as determined by the Board, to provide services to or on behalf of an employer or to the public. Such experience must be verified by an active, licensed CPA.

exams.name: CPA Examination (national uniform CPA examination)
exams.notes: Administered by the board of accountancy of a state or its designee; must be passed for initial Virginia licensure.
exams.jurisdiction: national (administered by board of accountancy of a state or its designee)
exams.quote: "CPA examination" means the national uniform CPA examination approved and administered by the board of accountancy of a state or by the board's designee.

required.quote: Establish continuing professional educational requirements as a condition for issuance, renewal, or reinstatement of a Virginia license.

available.quote: A person who holds the license of another state may obtain a Virginia license under this subsection.

requirements.value: Applicant must disclose all states of licensure, provide documentation of good standing, disclose any violations, demonstrate substantially equivalent education, pass the CPA examination, and meet CPE and experience requirements as determined by the Board.
requirements.quote: A person who holds the license of another state may obtain a Virginia license under this subsection. 1. To be considered for a Virginia license, the person seeking licensure shall: a. Disclose to the Board each state in which he holds or has held a license; b. Provide, for each state in which the person holds a license, documentation from the board of accountancy concerning whether he is in good standing...

exists.quote: The Board of Accountancy established under the former § 54.1-2000 and previously operating in the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation is hereby continued and reestablished as an independent board in the executive branch of state government.

is_mandatory.quote: A person must be licensed in order to use the CPA title in Virginia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the provisions of this chapter or any regulation, subpoena, or order of the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the provisions of this chapter or violation of any regulation, subpoena, or order of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining, renewing, or applying for reinstatement or lifting the suspension of a Virginia license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining, renewing, or applying for reinstatement or lifting the suspension of a Virginia license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or refusal to reinstate the license of another state for disciplinary reasons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, or refusal to reinstate the license of another state for disciplinary reasons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the privilege of practicing before any state or federal agency or federal court of law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the privilege of practicing before any state or federal agency or federal court of law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in providing services to or on behalf of an employer, to the public, or in attest, compilation, or financial statement preparation services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in providing services to or on behalf of an employer, in providing services to the public, or in providing attest services, compilation services, or financial statement preparation services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in preparing the person's or firm's own state or federal income tax return or financial statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in preparing the person's or firm's own state or federal income tax return or financial statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, or of any crime involving moral turpitude, under the laws of the United States, Virginia, or any other state if the acts would have constituted a crime under Virginia law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, or of any crime involving moral turpitude, under the laws of the United States, of Virginia, or of any other state if the acts involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of Virginia

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lack of the competence required to provide services to the public or to provide attest, compilation, or financial statement preparation services, as determined by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Lack of the competence required to provide services to the public for persons and entities located in Virginia or to provide attest services, compilation services, and financial statement preparation services to persons and entities located in Virginia, as determined by the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of public accounting" means the performance of professional services for a client by a licensee or licensee's firm.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accounting" means the performance of professional services for a client by a licensee or licensee's firm.

methods_authorized.quote: "Professional services" means all services requiring substantial use of accountancy or related skills that are performed by a licensee for a client or for an employer.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation services" means compiling financial statements in accordance with standards established by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or by any successor standard-setting authorities.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: provide documentation that he has obtained from one or more accredited institutions at least 150 semester hours of education, a baccalaureate or higher degree, and an accounting concentration or equivalent, as defined by the Board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: A person who (i) holds a license in good standing issued by another state, territory of the United States, or the District of Columbia and (ii) has passed the CPA examination shall be granted practice privilege to provide services to the public in the Commonwealth without notice to the Board or payment of any fees.

value: Consent to be subject to the provisions of this chapter and regulations promulgated by the Board that apply to the holder of a Virginia license

Consent to the Board's authority to revoke or suspend his privilege to use the CPA title in Virginia and to impose penalties

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: to use the CPA title in Virginia, the person shall: 1. Consent to be subject to: a. The jurisdiction of the Board in all disciplinary proceedings arising out of matters related to his use of the CPA title or providing services to the public in Virginia; and c. attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: Only a licensed firm can provide attest services, compilation services, or financial statement preparation services to persons or entities located in Virginia.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: At least 51 percent of the owners of the firm shall be licensees, trustees of an eligible employee stock ownership plan as defined in § 13.1-543, or a firm that meets this requirement

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: The Board shall prescribe requirements concerning the hours that owners who are not licensees work in the firm and may prescribe other requirements for those persons.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: If the services provided by the firm are within the scope of the practice-monitoring program of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or its successor, the firm shall enroll in the program or in another practice-monitoring program for attest services, compilation services, and financial statement preparation services that is approved by the Board.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm whose principal place of business is not in Virginia is not required to obtain a Virginia license but may provide attest services, compilation services, or financial statement preparation services to persons or entities located in Virginia if the following provisions are met

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: All attest services, compilation services, and financial statement preparation services provided for persons and entities located in Virginia shall be under the supervision of a person who either (i) holds a Virginia license or (ii) holds the license of another state and complies with the practice privilege provisions of § 54.1-4411.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any person who releases or authorizes the release of reports on attest services, compilation services, or financial statement preparation services provided for persons or entities located in Virginia shall: a. Either (i) hold a Virginia license or (ii) hold the license of another state and comply with the practice privilege provisions of § 54.1-4411; and b. Meet any additional requirements the Board prescribes.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The prohibitions of § 54.1-4414 and the other provisions of this chapter shall not be construed to preclude any person who is not licensed from including a statement on financial statements indicating that no assurance is provided on the financial statements or using the following language: "I (We) have compiled the accompanying (financial statements) of (name of entity) as of (time period) and for the (period) then ended..."

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The unlawful acts listed in § 54.1-4414 shall not apply to a person or entity holding a certification, designation, degree, or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accounting or its equivalent in the country, provided that: 1. The practice of the person or entity in Virginia is limited to providing services to persons or entities who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of the country in which the entitlement is held

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: If the death, retirement, or departure of an owner causes either of these requirements not to be met, the requirement shall be met within one year after the death, retirement, or departure of the owner.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Only a licensed firm can provide attest services, compilation services, or financial statement preparation services to persons or entities located in Virginia.
